This bit is set by hardware. It is cleared by software writing 1 to the corresponding bit
set. At the end of the transfer, the transfer complete flag (TCIF) is set and an interrupt is

guard.quote: R("DMA_HIFCR", 0x0C, "§15.5.4", "CTCIF4", 5, 5, Any, "inherited, unaudited (acknowledged by name)", "the stock model: writing 1 clears TCIFx and its interrupt (probed, TVI-WO-1303.measure.md D2; ArduPilot writes it)", 661),
return offset < CrOffset || offset >= StreamEnd ? -1 : (int)((offset - CrOffset) / StreamStep);
refused |= RefusedField(offset, r, word, width, s);

silicon.0x0: No effect: RM0433 states an effect only for writing 1 ("Writing 1 to this bit clears the corresponding TCIFx flag", p661); TCIF4 keeps its value.
silicon.0x1: Clears TCIF4 in DMA_HISR (p661); with TCIF4 clear the stream's transfer-complete interrupt (TCIF set and TCIE set, p657) is no longer requested.

twin.0x0: The guard passes the word (no stream rule for an IFCR offset, s = -1; the row is Any) and the stock callback ClearIrqFlagOnCondition(..., false) does nothing, so TCIF4 keeps its value.
twin.0x1: The guard passes the word to the stock model, whose ClearIrqFlagOnCondition clears transferCompleteIrqStatus[4] (the TCIF4 bit served in DMA_HISR); the guard then recomputes stream 4's line as TCIE (its copy) && TCIF (the stock model's) || HTIE && HTIF, so the interrupt drops unless HTIF/HTIE hold it.

observable_by_firmware: none: for the values written (0 and 1) the twin clears TCIF4 and its line exactly when silicon does. ArduPilot reads DMA_HISR and writes back the flags it found; the armed words carrying bit 5 (CTCIF4) are dma1 0x3D; no read of LIFCR/HIFCR occurs in the armed run (0 reads of offsets 0x8/0xC).
notes: Instances and words: items dma1@0x00C. Armed run words written to DMA_HIFCR: dma1: 0x3D, 0x800, 0xF40, 0x3D0000, 0xF400000, 0x8000000; bit 5 is 1 in dma1 0x3D and 0 in the rest (0 = no effect on both sides). Stream 4 on the armed platform: dma1 S4 spi1_tx (C4CR = 0x26), M2P. The flag this bit clears is DMA_HISR.TCIF4 (bit 5); when it is SET is that field's row, not this one: the stock model sets it only when NDT reaches 0 (STM32DMA.cs L259-261), which for a memory-to-peripheral stream is inside the EN write (the whole transfer moves at once), and the guard also sets it at a software disable of a running stream (Suspend, GuardedSTM32DMA.cs L410-415). LIFCR/HIFCR read back 0 in the stock model (FieldMode.Set has no read); RM0433 marks the bits w; no firmware reads them. The row cites p661; the CTCIF bit text is printed on p661 (p660 holds only the LIFCR heading). The generated boards write no DMA register (instance-accesses.tsv: no dma1/dma2 rows for them); the fixture ap-fx writes LIFCR/HIFCR words of the same shape (0x3D, 0x20, 0xF40, 0x3D0000, 0xF400000, 0x200000, 0x800). Stock `file` paths beginning `Main/` are relative to renode-src/inf/src/Emulator/; the others to renode-src/inf/src/Emulator/Peripherals/Peripherals/ (both in the pinned 066a7f13 tree).
